summary: Independent native review Profile design assessment, code lens with boundary and verification-risk assessment, of native-design-20261003-1 (SHA-256 9ed6f31e5ec6cea11545c114197e2381b6bb83b674a54926555e930cec2509f0). The design implements approved requirements native-author-20261003-3 through one shared controller/store authority, immutable field-group proposals, acknowledgment clearing restricted to submitted proposal versions, retained out-of-view editors, keyed/effect-restored focus and caret, and modal-free unknown recovery. Host display context is separate from action snapshots and write busy/unknown state; accepted context/result controls visible mode, capability checks prevent unsupported promises, and older replies cannot overwrite newer context. Metadata carriers and inline/fullscreen protocol match independently retrieved primary documents. Inline generated SVG with explicit accessible labels and no runtime fetch fits requested generated icons and self-contained resource composition. Tests cover pure/controller/host/generated DOM plus real Chromium narrow/broad/theme/zoom/modal evidence; check/build remain required. This verdict approves the design contract only: implementation behavior, browser evidence, hosted D1/auth/cache/modes and runtime kernel obligations are not executed or established. Latest primary protocol source is main rather than a pinned release; retain exact observation/version evidence when integrating.
